Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon unsuspends.
Upper Text: [When Attacking] You may play 1 [NSo] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 3 or less from your trash without paying the cost.
